sites.name: Apollo 11 (Tranquility Base)
sites.source: Coordinates of Lunar Anthropogenic Targets (LROC Science Operations Team, Arizona State University, 28 July 2016)
sites.note: LM coordinates, LROC NAC-derived, mean Earth/polar axis (ME) frame. Landing UTC from NSSDCA mission page https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/nmc/spacecraft/display.action?id=1969-059C ("Landed on Moon" / LM landing UT). NSSDCA LM page gives the same coordinates (DE421 mean Earth/polar axis) and 20:17:40 UT.

sites.name: Intuitive Machines IM-1 Odysseus (Malapert A area)
sites.source: Intuitive Machines IM-1 Nova-C Odysseus landing site (LROC featured image, NAC M1463440322L)
sites.note: LROC gives 80.13 S, 1.44 E, 2579 m, to two decimals only (about 1 km precision). Touchdown time 23:23:53 UTC from the same LROC page.

sites.name: Intuitive Machines IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton)
sites.source: IM-2 Athena lander, LROC featured image 'IM-2 Athena Seen Obliquely' (NAC M1495922531LR)
sites.note: Rest position in a 20 m crater, 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E per LROC (LROC 1408). UTC is INFERRED, minute precision: 11:30 a.m. CST from an IM release as reported secondhand. Both curl and WebFetch of the IM release returned HTTP 403, so it was not read. Wikipedia gives 17:28:50 UTC; LROC 1408 (image 23.5 h after touchdown) is consistent with about 17:30.

sites.name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1 (Mare Crisium, near Mons Latreille)
sites.source: Blue Ghost Lunar Lander Seen From Above (LROC featured image 1407, NAC M1495619099LR)
sites.note: LROC measured lander position 18.5623 N, 61.8103 E, -3650 m (LROC 1407; LROC 1406 gives 18.562 N, 61.810 E). The region-box centre from LROC 1400 is 18.56 N, 61.81 E. UTC minute precision: Firefly mission page gives 2:34 a.m. CST (UTC-6) = 08:34 UTC, no seconds.

sites.name: ispace HAKUTO-R Mission 2 Resilience (impact site, Mare Frigoris)
sites.source: ispace Mission 2 SMBC x HAKUTO-R Venture Moon Impact Site (LROC featured image, NAC M1504323448R)
sites.note: Impact (crash) site, not a landing: the dark smudge centre, 60.4445 N, 355.4120 E, -2431.6 m, converted to -4.5880. The time is the LROC-stated hard-landing/impact time, 5 June 2025 18:13 UTC, minute precision (no seconds given).

sites.name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram (Shiv Shakti Point)
sites.source: Chandrayaan-3 Landing Site (LROC featured image, NAC M1447750764LR)
sites.note: LROC gives 69.3741 S, 32.32 E, 532 m. UTC is minute precision from news reports (18:04 IST); the ISRO primary release was not retrieved, so the minute is unconfirmed.

sites.name: Chang'e-3 (Yutu, Mare Imbrium near Sinus Iridum)
sites.source: Coordinates of Lunar Anthropogenic Targets (LROC Science Operations Team, Arizona State University, 28 July 2016)
sites.note: LROC table, ME frame: 44.1214 N, 340.4883 E, converted to -19.5117. UTC minute precision from a state-media copy (descent after 1300 GMT, touchdown 11 minutes later), not a CNSA primary.

sites.name: Chang'e-4 (Von Karman crater, farside)
sites.source: Chang'e 4 Lander Coordinates (LROC post 1087)
sites.note: LROC: 45.457 S, 177.589 E, plus or minus 20 m. CNSA (via Xinhua) gives 45.5 S, 177.6 E at one-decimal precision. Disagreement above 0.01 deg: latitude gap 0.043 deg and longitude gap 0.011 deg, both attributed to CNSA one-decimal rounding. UTC minute precision from Xinhua: 10:26 a.m. Beijing time = 02:26 UTC.

sites.name: Chang'e-5 (Oceanus Procellarum, Mons Rumker region)
sites.source: Chang'e 5 First Look (LROC post 1172)
sites.note: LROC: 43.0576 N, 308.0839 E, -2570 m, +/- 20 m, converted to -51.9161. Touchdown 10:11 EST (15:11 UTC) 1 Dec 2020 from the same LROC page, minute precision.

sites.name: Chang'e-6 (Apollo basin, farside)
sites.source: First Look: Chang'e 6 (LROC featured image, NAC M1472410644L)
sites.note: LROC: 41.6385 S, 206.0148 E, -5256 m, +/- 30 m, converted to -153.9852. UTC is INFERRED and minute precision: CNSA announcement reported secondhand as 06:23 Beijing time 2 June 2024 = 22:23 UTC 1 June. The Xinhua/CNSA original was not retrieved; the CNSA English page (english.spacechina.com) confirms the landing but gives no time.

sites.name: JAXA SLIM (Shioli crater rim target)
sites.source: JAXA, Outcome for the Smart Lander for Investigating Moon (SLIM)'s Moon Landing (25 Jan 2024), with attached technical document jaxa_doc01_20240125_e.pdf
sites.note: Target landing site, ME frame, from JAXA. JAXA says touchdown was about 55 m east of target, so this is the target, not the measured rest point. UTC from JAXA report: landed about 00:19:52 JST 20 Jan 2024 = 15:19:52 UTC 19 Jan.

sites.name: Luna 25 (likely impact site, Pontécoulant G rim)
sites.source: NASA, "NASA's LRO Observes Crater Likely from Luna 25 Impact"
sites.note: Crash, not a landing: NASA calls the new ~10 m crater likely from Luna 25; time is NASA's estimated impact time (11:58 UTC).
